description.zh: 在 Operit 中复刻 X/Twitter 移动端：主页时间线、搜索、通知、私信聊天、个人主页；支持双账号、发帖、点赞转发收藏、图片视频上传，数据本地持久化。
description.en: X/Twitter mobile replica for Operit: home timeline, search, notifications, DM chat, profiles; dual accounts, posting, like/repost/bookmark, image & video upload, local persistence.

description.zh: 发帖、查状态、点赞、转发、收藏、删除、关注、主页资料、私信、通知等 X 社交模拟功能。
description.en: Post, status, like, retweet, bookmark, delete, follow, profile, DM, notifications for X social simulation.
